question: How will my career go, and when is the best time for a job change?

drafts.summary: The career picture is broadly supportive, led by Sun and Mercury together in the 10th house forming a Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga and a Budhaditya yoga [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja] [rule:yoga.budhaditya]. The house, lord, karaka, varga and panchanga votes all lean in favour of career [vote:career.house] [vote:career.lord] [vote:career.karaka] [vote:career.varga] [vote:career.panchanga]. The KP vote is the one dissenting voice, because the 10th cusp's sub-lord does not connect to the career houses [vote:career.kp].

claims.text: Sun and Mercury conjoined in the 10th house form Budhaditya yoga, lending intellect, communication skill and some reputation to the working life, though the yoga is somewhat moderated by a weak planetary state [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [text:Phaladeepika/Sastri-1937/18/1].

The same conjunction in the 10th joins the Sun as lord of the 4th with Mercury as lord of the 2nd and 5th, forming a Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga that points to authority, reputation and career standing [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/34/11-12].

Mars in the 7th house from the lagna forms Ruchaka yoga, adding courage and leadership, but the yoga is notably weakened by Saturn's aspect, an unfavourable star position from the Moon and Mars sitting in a difficult placement [rule:yoga.ruchaka] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/75/1-2].

Counted from the Sun, Mars falls in the 10th and again forms Ruchaka yoga, with the same weakening from Saturn's aspect, the star position from the Moon and the difficult placement [rule:yoga.ruchaka] [text:Phaladeepika/Sastri-1937/6/1].

The house vote favours career: although the 10th house from the lagna in Aquarius is the weakest of the group, the supporting 2nd, 6th and 11th houses are strong, and the 11th from the Sun in Sagittarius and the 11th from the Moon in Leo are especially well placed [vote:career.house].

The lord vote favours career: the 10th lord Saturn sits in the lagna in Taurus in a friendly sign though with low strength, the 6th lord Venus is exalted in Pisces in the 11th, and Mars, lord of the 10th from the Sun, is strong in its own sign Scorpio in the 7th [vote:career.lord].

The karaka vote favours career: the Sun and Mercury occupy the 10th house in Aquarius, the Sun in an enemy sign and Mercury neutral, Saturn sits in the lagna in a friendly sign with modest strength, and Venus is exalted and strong in the 11th [vote:career.karaka].

The varga vote leans slightly in favour: in the D10, Mars and Saturn in Capricorn and Venus in Gemini score positively, Moon and Mercury are neutral, while Jupiter in Aries and the Sun in Scorpio score against [vote:career.varga].

The KP vote goes against career: the 10th cusp lies in the Moon's star, and its sub-lord Ketu sits in the 8th house and owns no houses, so it does not link to the career houses 10, 6, 2 or 11 [vote:career.kp].

The panchanga vote favours career: Mars, as lord of the tithi and nakshatra, rules the 10th from the Sun and other area houses with good strength, and the Moon, as weekday lord, rules the 10th from the Moon and the 6th from the Sun, also with good strength [vote:career.panchanga].
